verses.text: Then a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman dressed with the sun, with the moon under her feet, and a crown of twelve stars on her head.
She was pregnant, and she cried out in pain because she was about to give birth.
Then another sign appeared in heaven: a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and seven crowns on its heads.

Its tail swept a third of the stars out of the sky and threw them down to the earth. The dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that it could eat her child the moment it was born.
She gave birth to a son, a boy, who will rule all the nations with an iron rod. Her child was snatched up to God and to his throne.
The woman ran away into the desert, to a place God had made ready for her, where she would be taken care of for one thousand two hundred and sixty days.
Then war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and its angels fought back.
But the dragon was not strong enough, and there was no longer any place for them in heaven.
The great dragon was thrown down. It is that old snake called the devil and Satan, who fools the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

Then I heard a loud voice in heaven say: "Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ have come. For the one who accuses our brothers and sisters has been thrown down. He accused them in front of our God day and night.
They won the victory over him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the message they told. They did not love their own lives so much that they were afraid to die.
So be glad, you heavens, and all who live in them! But how terrible for the earth and the sea, because the devil has come down to you. He is very angry, because he knows that his time is short."
When the dragon saw that it had been thrown down to the earth, it chased after the woman who had given birth to the boy.

But the woman was given the two wings of a great eagle, so that she could fly to her place in the desert. There she would be taken care of, away from the snake, for a time, two times, and half a time.
Then the snake poured water out of its mouth like a river after the woman, to sweep her away with the flood.
But the earth helped the woman. The earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had poured out of its mouth.
Then the dragon became very angry with the woman. It went off to make war against the rest of her children, those who obey God's commands and hold on to what Jesus said.
